name: @game-hub/game-container
description: Container (10th Anniversary Edition) as a single in-workspace game package — the Track D legacy-migration (phase 5) retrofit, and the heaviest: the first, largest and most host-coupled game. Four subpath exports over TypeScript source: ./engine (pure economic-supply-chain rules core, with a secret scoring card per player redacted by viewFor), ./module (backend GameModule using every optional hook — the delivery-auction routes over its own SQLite table, pendingStep, onStateChanged auction push, and a bot runner with the auction preStep), ./client (UI GameClient — original board/ship art + the BoardMap), ./bot (AI deciding from the redacted view: one-per-concern policies, sealed bids, self-play 3–5 players). Depends only on @game-hub/kernel (+ React for ./client, Fastify + better-sqlite3 types for ./module).
